title: Infinite Potential—Insights from the Societal Warfare Games: After-Action Report from a Sequence of Day After Artificial General Intelligence Exercises
summary_en: This report synthesizes observations from RAND’s Infinite Potential Societal Warfare games, which explored how domestic unrest related to advanced AI could be strategically exploited by U.S. adversaries.
